topic: OpenAI is enlisting an influencer army to make it look 'good for the world'
headline: OpenAI's Influencer Strategy Exposed
caption: As a full stack engineer, I find this trend both intriguing and concerning. Companies leveraging influencers to polish their image can blur the lines between genuine ethics and marketing spin. It raises questions about authenticity and the impact on public trust when tech giants craft narratives through hired voices. Transparency should be a top priority, especially when promoting AI we all rely on daily. Let's stay vigilant and critically evaluate the stories coming from these influence campaigns. 🤖 Keep coding and questioning! #AIEthics #TechTransparency #OpenAI #InfluencerEra #EngineersUnite
